SELECT -- af_collab 表字段 c.oid, c.workspace_id, c.owner_uid, c.partition_key, c.len, c.blob, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.indexed_at, NULL as title, -- af_collab没有title，从FolderView获取 'afCollab' as notebook_type, NULL as data -- af_collab没有data字段
FROM af_collab c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.owner_uid = #{ownerUid} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.partition_key = 0 -- 只查询文档笔记（Document类型）
UNION ALL
SELECT -- af_quick_note 表字段 q.quick_note_id as oid, q.workspace_id, q.uid as owner_uid, NULL as partition_key, -- quick_note没有partition_key NULL as len, -- quick_note没有len NULL as blob, -- quick_note没有blob NULL as deleted_at, -- quick_note没有deleted_at q.created_at, q.updated_at, NULL as indexed_at, -- quick_note没有indexed_at NULL as title, -- 需要从data字段提取或从其他地方获取 'quickNote' as notebook_type, q.data::text as data -- JSON格式的数据
FROM af_quick_note q WHERE q.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND q.uid = #{ownerUid}

SELECT -- af_collab 表字段 c.oid, c.workspace_id, c.owner_uid, c.partition_key, c.len, c.blob, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.indexed_at, NULL as title, 'afCollab' as notebook_type, NULL as data
FROM af_collab c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.partition_key = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT -- af_quick_note 表字段 q.quick_note_id as oid, q.workspace_id, q.uid as owner_uid, NULL as partition_key, NULL as len, NULL as blob, NULL as deleted_at, q.created_at, q.updated_at, NULL as indexed_at, NULL as title, 'quickNote' as notebook_type, q.data::text as data
FROM af_quick_note q WHERE q.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

SELECT -- af_collab 表字段 c.oid, c.workspace_id, c.owner_uid, c.partition_key, c.len, c.blob, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.indexed_at, NULL as title, 'afCollab' as notebook_type, NULL as data
FROM af_collab c WHERE c.oid = #{oid} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.partition_key = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT -- af_quick_note 表字段 q.quick_note_id as oid, q.workspace_id, q.uid as owner_uid, NULL as partition_key, NULL as len, NULL as blob, NULL as deleted_at, q.created_at, q.updated_at, NULL as indexed_at, NULL as title, 'quickNote' as notebook_type, q.data::text as data
FROM af_quick_note q WHERE q.quick_note_id = #{oid} limit 1;
